lead.event: Bank Mandiri opened a Rp40 trillion credit facility for Jhonlin Group
lead.headline: BMRI opens Rp40 trillion credit facility for Jhonlin Group
lead.blurb: Bank Mandiri’s facility is disbursed to Jhonlin Baratama and secured by JARR and PGUN shares, with Rp17 trillion realized as of 26 October. The funds support Jhonlin Group’s coal industry development and related capital expenditure. RHB Sekuritas analyst Andrey Wijaya called the risk manageable because the disbursed amount is about 1% of Bank Mandiri’s estimated Rp1,700 trillion loan portfolio, while noting the group concentration warrants monitoring. Bank Mandiri says collateral coverage is 150%, based on the shares’ lowest intraday prices over the past month, and the agreement includes top-up mechanisms.

earnings_guidance.event: MSIG Life reported easing health insurance claim ratios and measures to address medical inflation
earnings_guidance.headline: LIFE reports easing health claim ratios, with individual loss ratio at 92%
earnings_guidance.blurb: MSIG Life CEO & President Director Wianto Chen said premiums still exceed claims, while the group insurance loss ratio is around 85%. To address annual medical inflation of 17% to 20%, the company uses market-aligned repricing, fraud prevention and hospital cooperation on clinical pathways.

earnings_guidance.event: BCA reported Q3 results and raised its 2026 loan growth outlook
earnings_guidance.headline: BCA reports Q3 results and lifts 2026 loan growth outlook to 10% to 12%
earnings_guidance.blurb: The projection exceeds BCA’s initial 8% to 10% Bank Business Plan target, which it has not formally revised. Loans reached Rp1,063 trillion as of September, up 12.6% year on year, while consolidated net profit through Q3 was Rp45.2 trillion, up 4.2%.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: BIPP approved a Rp100.57 billion private placement
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BIPP approves Rp100.57 billion private placement
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Bhuwanatala will issue 502.87 million shares at Rp200 each, to be taken up by affiliates Safire Capital and Gratamulia Pratama. The proceeds will support working capital, business development and expansion without changing control. Issuance is scheduled for 4 November, with listing on 5 November.
